pairs.target: nàtiān wǎnshàng , tāmen méi bǎ mùchuí zhuāng hǎo .
pairs.english: That evening they didn't finish fitting the wooden strikers.
pairs.hanzi: 那天晚上，他们没把木锤装好。

pairs.target: jièlái de hénggān bǐ tú shàng duōchū yì jié , sāijìn dǎo cáo yǐhòu , yìtóu zǒng pèngdào jiá zuò .
pairs.english: The borrowed crossbar was longer than in the drawing; once in the guide groove, one end kept hitting a clamp.
pairs.hanzi: 借来的横杆比图上多出一截，塞进导槽以后，一头总碰到夹座。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiǎng jù duǎn , yīwén tíxǐng tā shì jiè de , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ liǎnggè jiá zuò wǎng lǐ nuó .
pairs.english: Mira wanted to saw it shorter. Iven reminded her it was borrowed, so Tavi moved both clamps inward.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉想锯短，伊文提醒她是借的，塔维便把两个夹座往里挪。

pairs.target: nuó wán cái fāxiàn , shǒu fàng bú jìnqù le .
pairs.english: Only afterward did they discover there was no room for his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 挪完才发现，手放不进去了。

pairs.target: xīdēng qián , tāmen chāidiào le bàngè jiàzi .
pairs.english: Before lights-out they dismantled half the frame.
pairs.hanzi: 熄灯前，他们拆掉了半个架子。

pairs.target: yīwén shōushí zhuōmiàn , niē zhe sāngè rén gǎiguò de tú , wèn míngtiān néng bunéng jiāo zhège .
pairs.english: Clearing the table, Iven held their jointly revised drawing and asked if they could submit that tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文收拾桌面，捏着三个人改过的图，问明天能不能交这个。

pairs.target: tā shuō de shì zhǐ shàng de mò tuán , búshì zhuāngzhì . mǐlā méiyǒu xiào .
pairs.english: He meant the ink blot on the paper, not the device. Mira didn't laugh.
pairs.hanzi:
他说的是纸上的墨团，不是装置。
米拉没有笑。

pairs.target: dìèrtiān zǎofàn hòu , sāngè rén dài zhe língjiàn huídào jiàoshì .
pairs.english: After breakfast next day, all three returned to class with their parts.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天早饭后，三个人带着零件回到教室。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān qù zhǎo wéi lǎoshī , shuōmíng hénggān tài cháng , wèn néng bunéng huàn .
pairs.english: Tavi first found Instructor Vey, explained the crossbar was too long, and asked to swap it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先去找维老师，说明横杆太长，问能不能换。

pairs.target: tā cóng guìzi lǐ tiāo le yìgēn duǎn de , ràng tā bǎ liǎnggēn dōu liáng yíbiàn , bié zài kào yǎnjīng cāi .
pairs.english: She chose a shorter one from the cupboard and told him to measure both instead of guessing by eye again.
pairs.hanzi: 她从柜子里挑了一根短的，让他把两根都量一遍，别再靠眼睛猜。

pairs.target: lí lún dào tāmen háiyǒu yíduànshíjiān .
pairs.english: There was still time before their turn.
pairs.hanzi: 离轮到他们还有一段时间。

pairs.target: yīwén zhàozhe zuóyè zuìhòu nà zhāng tú zhuāng dǎo cáo , mǐlā gùdìng gāngtiáo , tǎ wéi guà xiǎo fǎmǎ .
pairs.english: Iven fitted the guide from last night's final drawing, Mira secured the strips, and Tavi hung small weights.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文照着昨夜最后那张图装导槽，米拉固定钢条，塔维挂小砝码。

pairs.target: liǎngzhī yíyàng qīng de xiǎo líng piàn fēnbié xì zài gāngtiáo duāntóu , pángbiān de mùchuí bìngpái lián zài hénggān shàng .
pairs.english: Two equally light bell plates hung from the strip ends; wooden strikers beside them were attached side by side to the crossbar.
pairs.hanzi: 两只一样轻的小铃片分别系在钢条端头，旁边的木锤并排连在横杆上。

pairs.target: yīwén yán cáo tuī hénggān , mùchuí biàn cóng gùdìng de gāodù sǎoguòqù , búyòng pèng tǎ wéi de shǒu .
pairs.english: When Iven pushed the bar along the groove, the strikers swept past at a fixed height without touching Tavi's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文沿槽推横杆，木锤便从固定的高度扫过去，不用碰塔维的手。

pairs.target: qǐchū zuǒbiān líng piàn zhènghǎo zài chuítóu qián , yòubiān dī yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Initially the left plate was level with its striker; the right was a little lower.
pairs.hanzi: 起初左边铃片正好在锤头前，右边低一点。

pairs.target: jiè xìng yǐhòu , zuǒbiān gāngtiáo duō wān yìdiǎn , líng piàn wǎng xià duǒkāi ; yòubiān shǎo wān yìdiǎn , líng piàn táigāo , huàn tā shòu qiāo .
pairs.english: With property borrowing, the left strip bent farther, lowering its plate out of the way; the right bent less, raising its plate to be struck instead.
pairs.hanzi: 借性以后，左边钢条多弯一点，铃片往下躲开；右边少弯一点，铃片抬高，换它受敲。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān de jiànxì dōu hěnxiǎo , mǐlā dūn zhe tiáo le hǎojiǔ .
pairs.english: Both gaps were tiny; Mira crouched a long time adjusting them.
pairs.hanzi: 两边的间隙都很小，米拉蹲着调了好久。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎshǒu fàngdào jiēchù de wèizhì , gěi tāmen kàn hái néng bunéng huódòng .
pairs.english: Tavi placed his hands at the contact points to show whether he could still move them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把手放到接触的位置，给他们看还能不能活动。

pairs.target: zhǐjié méiyǒu pèng jiá zuò , mùchuí yě gòu búdào shǒubèi .
pairs.english: His knuckles didn't touch the clamps, and the strikers couldn't reach the backs of his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 指节没有碰夹座，木锤也够不到手背。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī guòlái , jiǎnchá le zhòngliàng , jiá zuò hé hénggān xíngchéng , ràng tāmen xiān kōng tuī yìhuí .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked weights, clamps, and bar travel, then had them try a pass without a link.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师过来，检查了重量、夹座和横杆行程，让他们先空推一回。

alignment.english: try a pass without a link

pairs.target: zuǒ língxiǎng , yòu líng méi xiǎng .
pairs.english: The left bell rang; the right didn't.
pairs.hanzi: 左铃响，右铃没响。

pairs.target: " kěyǐ shì . " tā shuō , " bié wèile děng tā xiǎng , yìzhí lián zhe . "
pairs.english: “You can try,” she said. “Don't keep the link just waiting for a ring.”
pairs.hanzi: “可以试。”她说，“别为了等它响，一直连着。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu . zhè yícì tā búpà búhuì zuò , fǎndǎo pà liǎnggè rén dōu děng zhe tā , zìjǐ yòu zuò bù chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded. This time he feared not ignorance but failing with both of them waiting for him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头。这一次他不怕不会做，反倒怕两个人都等着他，自己又做不出来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǎngxīn de hàn cā zài kùzǐ shàng , tiēzhù liǎnggēn gāngtiáo .
pairs.english: He wiped his sweaty palms on his trousers and touched both strips.
pairs.hanzi: 他把掌心的汗擦在裤子上，贴住两根钢条。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn kèxiàn , yīwén fú hénggān , děng tā táiqǐ shǒuzhǐ .
pairs.english: Mira watched the marks. Iven held the bar, waiting for her raised finger.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看刻线，伊文扶横杆，等她抬起手指。

pairs.target: chángtiáo xiàngxià dòng le . yīwén tuīguòqù , liǎngzhī líng dōu xiǎng le .
pairs.english: The long strip moved down. Iven pushed, and both bells rang.
pairs.hanzi:
长条向下动了。
伊文推过去，两只铃都响了。

pairs.target: shēngyīn hěn qīng , què fēndeqīng , yìqiányīhòu , xiàng yǒurén shuōwán yíjù , yòu chā le yíjù zuǐ .
pairs.english: Faint but distinct, one after the other, like a sentence followed by an interruption.
pairs.hanzi: 声音很轻，却分得清，一前一后，像有人说完一句，又插了一句嘴。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sōngkāi . mǐlā zhòu zhe méi kàn fèngxì , yīwén bǎ hénggān lāhuílái , shuō búshì tā qiāo le liǎngbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi released. Mira frowned at the gaps; Iven pulled the bar back, saying he hadn't struck twice.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维松开。米拉皱着眉看缝隙，伊文把横杆拉回来，说不是他敲了两遍。

pairs.target: méi rén shuō shì , dàn tā yòu chóngfù le yícì . " xiān biédòng . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: Nobody had said he had, but he repeated it. “Don't move yet,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
没人说是，但他又重复了一次。
“先别动。”塔维说。

pairs.target: gāngcái tā chōu shǒu shí , dǐbǎn biānshàng de zhǐ jiǎo dǒu le yíxià .
pairs.english: When he'd withdrawn his hands, a paper corner beside the base had trembled.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才他抽手时，底板边上的纸角抖了一下。

pairs.target: xiànzài mǐlā zhǐshì bǎ gēbo fàngdào zhuōshàng , nà zhǐ jiǎo yòu dǒu le , yòubiān líng piàn yě gēnzhe huàng .
pairs.english: Now Mira merely rested an arm on the table and the corner trembled again, the right bell plate swaying with it.
pairs.hanzi: 现在米拉只是把胳膊放到桌上，那纸角又抖了，右边铃片也跟着晃。

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàqù , fāxiàn dǐbǎn yìjiǎo méiyǒu tiēzhù zhuōmiàn .
pairs.english: He crouched and found one corner of the base wasn't flush with the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下去，发现底板一角没有贴住桌面。

pairs.target: yīwén tuī dào dǎo cáo jìntóu shí , hénggān zhuàng shàng dǎng tóu , zhěngkuài dǐbǎn huì chàn .
pairs.english: When Iven pushed to the groove's end, the bar hit its stop, shaking the whole base.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文推到导槽尽头时，横杆撞上挡头，整块底板会颤。

pairs.target: gāngtiáo gēnzhe dòng , líng piàn biàn kěnéng pèngdào bùgāi pèng de mùchuí .
pairs.english: The strips moved too, letting a bell plate catch the wrong striker.
pairs.hanzi: 钢条跟着动，铃片便可能碰到不该碰的木锤。

pairs.target: " búshì zhǐyǒu wǒ ràng tā dòng . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “I'm not the only thing moving it,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “不是只有我让它动。”塔维说。

pairs.target: mǐlā ná kāi gēbo , ràng yīwén zài tǎ wéi bù jiēchù gāngtiáo shí zài tuī yícì . liǎngzhī líng háishì xiǎng le .
pairs.english: Mira moved her arm and had Iven push again without Tavi touching the strips. Both bells still rang.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿开胳膊，让伊文在塔维不接触钢条时再推一次。两只铃还是响了。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe nà kuài qiàoqǐ de bǎn jiǎo , liǎn hūrán hóng le .
pairs.english: She stared at the raised corner, suddenly blushing.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯着那块翘起的板角，脸忽然红了。

pairs.target: " zuówǎn wǒ nuó guò zhèlǐ . " " wǒ yě nuó guò . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “I moved this last night.” “So did I,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi:
“昨晚我挪过这里。”
“我也挪过。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " wǒ huà guò . " yīwén bǎ nà tuán mò fàngdào pángbiān , " kěyǐ yìqǐ suàn . "
pairs.english: “I drew it.” Iven set the ink blot beside them. “We can share the blame.”
pairs.hanzi: “我画过。”伊文把那团墨放到旁边，“可以一起算。”

pairs.target: tāmen zhǎo lái báo mùpiàn diànpíng dǐbǎn , yòng jiāzi bǎ tā gùdìng zài zhuō yán , yòu zài dǎng tóuqián chán le yìxiǎokuài ruǎnbù .
pairs.english: They leveled the base with thin wooden shims, clamped it to the table edge, and wrapped soft cloth in front of the stop.
pairs.hanzi: 他们找来薄木片垫平底板，用夹子把它固定在桌沿，又在挡头前缠了一小块软布。

pairs.target: yīwén tuī màn yìdiǎn , kōng tuī shí zhōngyú zhī xiǎng zuǒ líng .
pairs.english: With Iven pushing slower, an unlinked pass finally rang only the left bell.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文推慢一点，空推时终于只响左铃。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu mǎshàng jiào tǎ wéi dòngshǒu , érshì shēn zhǐtou yā le yā sìgè jiǎo , quèrèn búzài qiào dòng .
pairs.english: Rather than call Tavi at once, Mira pressed each corner to check it no longer rocked.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有马上叫塔维动手，而是伸指头压了压四个角，确认不再翘动。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī qù kàn lìngyìzǔ , ràng tāmen xiān xiūxi .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey went to another team, telling them to rest.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师去看另一组，让他们先休息。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hēshuǐ shí , kànjiàn luò héng nàbiān yǐjīng zuòchéng le .
pairs.english: Drinking water, Tavi saw Lohen's team had already succeeded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝水时，看见洛衡那边已经做成了。

pairs.target: nà zǔ de língshēng bú dà , huàn xiǎng què hěn gānjìng , zhǐ shàng de jìlù yě bú luàn .
pairs.english: Their bells were quiet but switched cleanly, their notes neat too.
pairs.hanzi: 那组的铃声不大，换响却很干净，纸上的记录也不乱。

pairs.target: luò héng zhèngzài bǎ yìzhī piānxié de diànpiàn zhuǎnzhèng , sìhū bìng bù jí zhe kàn biérén .
pairs.english: Lohen was straightening a crooked washer, apparently in no hurry to watch anyone else.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡正在把一只偏斜的垫片转正，似乎并不急着看别人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yíhuìer , huídào zìjǐ de zhuōbiān . " zài lái yícì . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi watched a while, then returned to his table. “One more try,” he said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维看了一会儿，回到自己的桌边。
“再来一次。”他说。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī huílái hòu , mǐlā bǎ gāngcái diànguò de dìfāng zhǐ gěi tā kàn . tā jiǎnchá wán , zhàn dào cèmiàn , méi cuī .
pairs.english: When Instructor Vey returned, Mira showed her the shims. She inspected them and stood aside without hurrying them.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师回来后，米拉把刚才垫过的地方指给她看。她检查完，站到侧面，没催。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèhuí xiān kàn liǎngbiān de líng piàn , děng tāmen dōu bú huàng le , cái bǎ zhùyìlì fàngjìnqù .
pairs.english: This time Tavi watched both plates until they stopped swaying, then let his attention enter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这回先看两边的铃片，等它们都不晃了，才把注意力放进去。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān wǎng xià , yòubiān wǎng shàng . mǐlā de shǒuzhǐ táiqǐ , yīwén tuī hénggān , mùchuí sǎo guò , yòubiān xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Left down, right up. Mira raised her finger, Iven pushed the bar, the strikers swept past, and the right bell rang once.
pairs.hanzi: 左边往下，右边往上。米拉的手指抬起，伊文推横杆，木锤扫过，右边响了一声。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān ānjìng .
pairs.english: The left stayed silent.
pairs.hanzi: 左边安静。

pairs.target: tā sōngkāi , shǒuzhǐ líkāi gāngtiáo , děng tāmen huídào yuánwèi .
pairs.english: He released, lifting his fingers from the strips, and waited for them to return.
pairs.hanzi: 他松开，手指离开钢条，等它们回到原位。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ hénggān tuìhuí , zài tuī . zuǒbiān xiǎng le .
pairs.english: Iven drew the bar back and pushed again. The left rang.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把横杆退回，再推。左边响了。

pairs.target: sāngè rén dōu méiyǒu lìkè shuōhuà .
pairs.english: None of them spoke at once.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人都没有立刻说话。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān qù kàn yòu líng shìbushì kǎzhù , bō le yíxià xìxiàn , cái chángcháng chū le yìkǒuqì . " búshì kǎzhù . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Mira first checked whether the right bell was stuck, flicked its thread, and let out a long breath. “Not stuck,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉先去看右铃是不是卡住，拨了一下细线，才长长出了一口气。
“不是卡住。”她说。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zài jìlù shàng xiě le jǐbǐ , shuō zhèhuí kànqīng le , xiàcì háiyào néng zhàoyàngzuò chūlái .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey made notes, saying this attempt was clear; next time they must reproduce it.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师在记录上写了几笔，说这回看清了，下次还要能照样做出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎshǒu fàng píng , mōlemō zìjǐ de zhǐjiān , méiyǒu fāmá , yě méiyǒu nàzhǒng nábùzhǔn dōngxī zài nǎlǐ de gǎnjué .
pairs.english: Tavi laid his hands flat and felt his fingertips: no numbness, no uncertainty about where things were.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把手放平，摸了摸自己的指尖，没有发麻，也没有那种拿不准东西在哪里的感觉。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ tú shōu hǎo , méi jí zhe chāi .
pairs.english: They put away the drawing without rushing to dismantle the device.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把图收好，没急着拆。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō yīnggāi gěi zhuāngzhì qǐ gè míngzì , mǐlā shuō xiān bǎ zuówǎn chāi xià de luódīng zhǎoqí .
pairs.english: Iven said the device needed a name; Mira said first find all the screws removed last night.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说应该给装置起个名字，米拉说先把昨晚拆下的螺钉找齐。

pairs.target: tā zài zhuō dǐ zhǎodào liǎngkē , yòu cóng zìjǐ de xiùkǒu lǐ dǒuchū yìkē .
pairs.english: He found two under the table, then shook one more from his cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 他在桌底找到两颗，又从自己的袖口里抖出一颗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ nà kē jiē zhù , fàngjìn hézi .
pairs.english: Tavi caught it and put it in the box.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把那颗接住，放进盒子。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ dìyīcì tīngjiàn liǎnggēn gāngtiáo de shēngyīn shí , zìjǐ hái fēnbùqīng nǎ yìshēng cóng nǎlǐ lái .
pairs.english: He remembered first hearing the two strips, unable to tell which sound came from where.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起第一次听见两根钢条的声音时，自己还分不清哪一声从哪里来。

pairs.target: xiànzài zhuōshàng yǒu liǎngzhī líng , tā zhīdào gāi děng nǎyìzhī .
pairs.english: Now there were two bells on the table, and he knew which to wait for.
pairs.hanzi: 现在桌上有两只铃，他知道该等哪一只。

pairs.target: zǒuchū jiàoshì , mǐlā hūrán tíngxià , huítóu shuō : " gāngcái zài xiǎng yíxià jiù hǎo le . "
pairs.english: Outside the classroom, Mira suddenly stopped and turned. “I'd have liked one more ring.”
pairs.hanzi: 走出教室，米拉忽然停下，回头说：“刚才再响一下就好了。”

pairs.english: Iven asked which one. “Either.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文问哪只。
“都行。”
